summary: Learn Agile Project Management with JIRA through our comprehensive training course. Master the tools and techniques to enhance your project management skills.
lede: Jira Agile training helps project, product, and delivery professionals plan and coordinate iterative work using Jira. Participants practice prioritizing backlogs, planning sprint capacity, and configuring workflows and boards. They also learn to map dependencies, interpret flow metrics, forecast delivery, and create dashboards that support stakeholder decisions.
audienceIntro: This Agile Project Management course suits professionals who already work with projects, products, software teams, or operational change and need stronger control of iterative delivery. It is designed for roles that use Jira or need to introduce more disciplined Agile planning and reporting.
modules: Agile Foundations and Jira Delivery Context
prerequisites: Bring a laptop with access to a browser. TrainingCred can provide a demonstration Jira Software environment or use your organization’s non-production project space, subject to access and security approval. You do not need to install development software or write code. A current project, product backlog, or delivery challenge will help you produce more relevant exercises.
